articles.summary: Collaboration supports the development of DingoBlu’s mobile-first financial platform and Visa debit card program DingoBlu Financial, Inc., a financial technology company developing a mobile-first platform for personal financial products, today announced a strategic partnership with MVB Bank, Inc. The partnership represents an important milestone as DingoBlu prepares to introduce its platform and suite of financial products. DingoBlu is a Visa fintech partner, and its debit card program will run on the Visa network through its bank partner, MVB Bank. Through the relationship, MVB Bank will provide the regulated banking infrastructure supporting eligible DingoBlu deposit products and related banking services, while DingoBlu will provide the technology platform and digital experience through which clients can access and manage their accounts. DingoBlu is developing a streamlined mobile experience designed to help clients manage their everyday finances more conveniently. Planned offerings
articles.title: MVB Bank Announces Strategic Partnership With DingoBlu Financial

articles.summary: Kobalt Labs, an AI-powered platform that automates risk assessments and compliance workflows for financial institutions, is partnering with MVB Bank, a trusted leader in financial services, to automate manual compliance workflows for fintech partner collaboration, due diligence, ongoing monitoring and marketing compliance. The platform will elevate and streamline the MVB partner experience while simultaneously enhancing MVBs oversight and risk management capabilities. Kobalts goal is to transform compliance into a scalable, AI-driven capability that addresses increasing regulatory complexity and reduces reliance on manual processes across financial institutions.
